mapper.select: SELECT c.ID AS COMMENT_ID, c.SENDER_MEMBER_ID AS MEMBER_ID, me.NICKNAME AS NICKNAME, c.CONTENT AS CONTENT, c.CREATED_AT AS CREATED_AT FROM COMMENTS c JOIN MEMBER me ON me.ID = c.SENDER_MEMBER_ID WHERE c.MISSION_LOG_ID = #{missionLogId} ORDER BY c.CREATED_AT, c.ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COMMENTS (MISSION_LOG_ID, SENDER_MEMBER_ID, CONTENT) VALUES (#{missionLogId}, #{senderMemberId}, #{content})
